|Guide and ofttimes leader within the Citadel's Choir.<hr/>Bugs like these crossed the caves to bring me to Pharloom. I cut down many before my capture. Then I had thought them minded and cunning. Now I can see the  singular will that haunts them all.

<b>Envoys</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are leaders of [[the Choir]] often found guiding other choirbugs.<ref>Envoy [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Guide and ofttimes leader within the Citadel's Choir."</i></ref>
==Background==
Envoys, [[Choristor]]s, and [[Reed]]s were issued by [[the Citadel]] to different parts of the world, tasked with capturing any surviving descendants of the line of [[Weavers]].<ref>[[The Cradle]] lore tablet: <i>"Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, frail with age. Tracked and taken in Sandsea Waste. Seven Choristors, nine Envoys lost to task."</i></ref><ref>[[The Cradle]] lore tablet: <i>"Weaver, in eighth part, last of their line, mortally wounded. Tracked and taken in the Blackbarrens. Four Choristors, one Reed lost to task."</i></ref>

[[Hornet (Lore)|Hornet]] was captured and escorted to the kingdom of [[Pharloom]] by a troop of Envoys with a rune cage.<ref><i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> opening cutscene</ref><ref>[[Choral Commandment]]: ''"Full Chamber to the kingdom of the White Wyrm. Claim the Weaver, in half part. Last of their line. Sensed strong with Silk. Resistance anticipated. Quell with rune cage."''</ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
They are often seen leading several other choirbugs throughout the halls of the Choral Chambers. Once Hornet is in range, they use one of two attacks:
* <b>Overhead Swing:</b> Does a large overhead swing with their staff.
** A second, larger swing that the Envoy steps forward for may sometimes be performed after the first swing.
* <b>Charge:</b> Holds their staff like a lance and charges at Hornet, not stopping until she is behind it or it hits a wall. Parrying the attack is quite easy, and often the best choice for preventing damage.

All of their attacks and contact deal {{Damage|1}}.

An Envoy with 48 HP appears west of the [[Bellway]] fighting [[Second Sentinel]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
|columns=2
|
* Raise your voices, chosen few!
* The song sustains!
* Holy call of the Citadel...
* Fill the chambers, sacred song...
* Our voices will be heard!
* For our song, the precious Silk!
* Waver not! Wither not!
* All must gather! All must sing!
}}
== Location ==
Envoys can be mainly found throughout the [[Choral Chambers]], but one appears at the start of [[the Forum]] [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)#High_Halls|gauntlet]] in the [[High Halls]].

The Envoy directly west of the [[Grand Bellway]] will only spawn once [[First Shrine]] is activated.

==Trivia==
* The opening cutscene features a group of 7-8 Envoys, 4 of whom carry a bell-staff. When the bridge collapses they fall down along with Hornet, and when Hornet gets out of [[Moss Grotto]], their bodies can be found lying around.
** 6 bodies can be found, 3 on the ground, and 3 higher above [[Bone Bottom]]. Next to one of these is a [[Choral Commandment]] that bears the edict of Hornet's capture.
*Envoys do not respond to the Needolin once they become hostile.
* Envoys share their Needolin dialogue with [[Choir Bellbearer]]s, [[Choristor]]s, and [[Reed]]s.
